reasoning: This is a specialized UI editor chrome glyph for 'select text' or 'text box tool' (an I-beam cursor paired with a dotted marquee). Outside of software/UI design tasks about text inputs or selection bugs, ordinary users rarely have to-do items whose subject is a text cursor or selection marquee, and at small sizes it looks like an abstract letter I with dots.
